newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston forms LatAm forex unit.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston forms LatAm forex unit.

text.p: BankBoston has formed a Latin American foreign exchange unit comprised of six professionals in its Boston location, the bank said on Wednesday.
The unit will provide services in the areas of market risk management, liquidity, deal execution, sales, trading, marketing, credit and operations and systems, the bank said.
The group will be headed by Pedro Piedra, a recent hire from Chase Manhattan Corp in New York.
BankBoston maintains franchises in Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Panama, Uruguay and Peru, the bank said.
